title: saasaloy.json — consumer manifest
description: Alias map + installed-module list that lives at a generated project's root. Resolves module file targets and drives dependsOn resolution (build spec §3.2).

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema for editor validation.

aliases.description: Alias → path-prefix map. Keys are `@`-prefixed aliases (e.g. `@api`); values are project-relative directories a module's file targets resolve against.

additionalProperties.description: Project-relative path prefix (POSIX separators, no leading slash).

name.description: The project's name, written once by `saasaloy init`. It is the `{{PROJECT_NAME}}` the base template was rendered with, so `update` re-renders with the same value rather than deriving one from the directory name. Absent in a project scaffolded before this field existed; the tool then falls back to the root package.json `name`.

base.description: The base app `saasaloy init` scaffolded (e.g. `web`). It is not a module: the tool never applied it, it has no descriptor and no lock entry, so it never takes part in dependsOn resolution or conflict checks. Absent in a project scaffolded before this field existed; `saasaloy` migrates such a project on its next write.

testing.description: The project's testing mode (#242, ADR 0053). `off` ships no module tests, `tests-after` ships each module's tests and asks for a test with every change, `tdd` asks for the failing test first. `saasaloy init` writes it and `saasaloy testing <mode>` changes it, together with the marked block in the root `AGENTS.md`. Absent in a project scaffolded before this field existed; the tool then reads `off`.

theme.description: The project's Saasaloy UI theme (plan 0121): the token set `saasaloy init --theme=<name>` wrote into `packages/ui/src/styles/brand.css` and recorded in `apps/web/DESIGN.md`. `init` writes the key only for a theme other than `neutral`, so a later render writes the same bytes. Absent reads as `neutral`. It decides what `init` writes; changing it later rewrites no file.

template.description: The Saasaloy UI template (plan 0121) `saasaloy init --template=<name>` started from: a theme, a block kit and an ordered block list. `init` writes the key only when a template was named. It decides what `init` writes; changing it later rewrites no file.

kit.description: The Saasaloy UI block kit `init` wrote into `packages/ui/src/blocks/` (plan 0121). `init` writes the key only for a kit other than `ink`, so a later render writes the same bytes. Absent reads as `ink`. It decides what `init` writes; changing it later rewrites no file.

blocks.description: The landing page's blocks in order (plan 0121), as `saasaloy init --template` or `--blocks` composed `apps/web/src/pages/index.astro`. `init` writes the key only when the list is not the base page, so a later render writes the same bytes. Absent reads as the base page. It decides what `init` writes; changing it later rewrites no file.

installed.description: Modules present in this project. Grows as `saasaloy add` runs; drives dependsOn resolution.
